name: Zukk'ash Report
summary: At Camp Mojache, Hadoken Swiftstrider says your work against the Zukk'ash has gone doubly well, though danger remains. He asks you to carry the camp's report to Zilzibin Drumlore in Orgrimmar.

sections.title: A Document for the Drag
sections.body: Hadoken Swiftstrider has a document about what Camp Mojache has learned of the Zukk'ash insects. Their threat remains, so he asks you to take the report to Orgrimmar. Zilzibin Drumlore lives in the Drag and knows alien creatures like these. Hadoken hopes the camp's findings will prove useful.

sections.title: The Expert's Verdict
sections.body: Zilzibin Drumlore has been expecting the report. He calls the creatures you faced an ancient threat the Horde keeps choosing to ignore. Hadoken was wise to send both the document and you. Zilzibin names the Zukk'ash as silithid. Some dismiss them as a mindless nuisance, but he says they threaten the Horde more than the Alliance could.

faq.q: Who sends the report to Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Hadoken Swiftstrider gives you the document at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

faq.q: To whom is the report delivered?
faq.answer: You deliver the report to Zilzibin Drumlore, who lives in the Drag of Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Why is the document taken to Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: Hadoken hopes Zilzibin Drumlore can put the camp's findings to use. Zilzibin is an expert on alien creatures like the Zukk'ash.
The delivery follows your efforts against the Zukk'ash insects in Zukk'ash Infestation and Stinglasher.
